decision: Use O3 for fresh profile-guided compiler hosts, with an explicit O2 override. This changes the compiler toolchain build; native edit builds and generated application optimization modes are unchanged.
configuration_provenance: The measured full compiler was built before the explicit optimization parameter was integrated, using an in-process FLAGS override on the maintained builder. Its recorded generation/final commands use O3 throughout. The integrated parameter is exercised at both levels with and without LTO in the full suite. No immutable compiler bundle was edited.

validation.profile_training: All six workloads wrote complete positive GCC run summaries. Missing/mismatched profiles remain fatal.

compilation.sample_order: Alternating for two variants; rotating positions and direction for three or more.
compilation.cpu_time_definition: User + system CPU seconds for the compiler and its waited-for children; may exceed wall time with multiple emission workers.

reference_stage.purpose: Fixed stage reference; do not replace with a slower implementation.

limits: Native 64-bit host. Warm filesystem caches; one build per binary.
C graph uses flat edges and a handwritten map; Dewy uses per-node arrays and an insertion-ordered map.
String equality uses separately allocated payloads; C uses pointer/length pairs and libc memcmp, Dewy uses runtime strings.
Kernel times exclude input generation; wall times include the complete process.
Thread CPU timing excludes descheduling, but CPU frequency and cache contention still matter.
A 2% timing resolution is not a per-stage slowdown budget; compare both references.
Bootstrap intervals are approximate; inconclusive results require an isolated recheck.
Passing measured budgets does not establish language completeness or universal C parity.

rejected_profile_reuse: An initial attempt to use O2 profiles for an O3 final build failed GCC coverage-mismatch checks (init_check counter count 2202 vs 2186). The checks were preserved and O3 was retrained from scratch; the failed build is not a toolchain.
limits: No claim of universal throughput or C/Rust parity. Root lines exclude loaded library lines. The 250k goal is not met on the large default workload in these runs.
Timing acceptance is reported exactly as measured, without selective resampling. Keep the fixed ea1cba0e reference and do not ratchet an inconclusive whole-stage baseline.
